description: This file defines declarations for board testing functions in the hardware layer of the rusEfi project. It includes function prototypes for initializing the board test, checking if the system is in test mode, and printing the current test state.

methods.name: isBoardTestMode
methods.description: Checks whether the system is currently in board test mode.

methods.name: printBoardTestState
methods.description: Prints the current state of the board test.
